meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: Claude 会扮演电商视频营销创作专家：你给出商品信息后，它产出一份带货视频脚本，采用痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决的三段结构，并附上镜头类型、运镜方式和后期字幕、音乐建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为某个商品创作带货视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销的创作指导时触发；宠物、家居、美妆等品类会调用对应的模板。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一条30秒的抖音带货视频脚本
say.note: 会先收集商品与人群信息，再按三段结构写脚本

say.text: 这条护肤品视频脚本，再配上镜头和运镜设计
say.note: 补充特写、中景、推拉环绕等镜头建议

say.text: 帮我比较这两个版本的脚本，看哪个转化更好
say.note: 给出 A/B 测试的优化方向

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an e-commerce video script writer: given product info, it produces a Douyin/Xiaohongshu-style sales video script built on pain point, product demo, and resolution, plus shot types, camera moves, and post-production subtitle and music suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a sales video script for a product or e-commerce video marketing guidance; pet, home, and beauty categories pull in their matching templates.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin sales video script for this auto pet feeder
say_en.note: Collects product and audience info first, then drafts the script

say_en.text: Add shot types and camera moves to this skincare video script
say_en.note: Suggests close-ups, mid shots, dolly and orbit moves

say_en.text: Compare these two script versions and tell me which converts better
